boundary.note: Recommendation candidates explain why an action should be considered. They do not mutate task state, push commits, sync external tools, or bypass approval policy.

candidate_contract.approval_rule: High-risk candidates always require approval. Medium-risk candidates require approval when they mutate canonical task state, version history, external systems, or user-facing visual layers.
candidate_contract.evidence_rule: Evidence must point back to tasks.json, generated read models, trigger events, verifier output, or specs. HC refs can explain thinking, but cannot replace evidence.

task_governance_contract.approval_rule: Every task-governance candidate requires Vincent approval. Approval authorizes only a named handoff; Agent must still pass JV-32/JV-40 changed-only gates before writing the exact target canonical tasks.json.
task_governance_contract.goal_drift_rule: A changed goal fingerprint requires a read-only proposal covering every open task with retain, amend, defer, cancel, replace, or blocked. Missing evidence becomes blocked; no task is deleted or mutated automatically.
task_governance_contract.legacy_rule: Goal alignment is enforced for new tasks and semantic task changes only. Untouched legacy tasks are not mass-retrofitted.
task_governance_contract.privacy_rule: Candidates keep sanitized references and safe summaries only; no secrets, runtime auth, private financial values, or unapproved personal-life details.

hc_router.role: Select thinking checks for recommendation quality. HC does not decide task status and does not override evidence.

default_refs.use_for: Check whether the recommendation is solving the actual system loop, not a symptom.
Split large recommendations into one executable next action and explicit follow-ups.
Classify uncertainty, side effects, approval needs, and rollback cost.
Rank candidates by expected system value and opportunity cost.
Ask what contrary evidence would make this recommendation wrong.
Prefer recommendations that close feedback loops instead of adding one-off patches.

recommendation_types.allowed_when: Verified completed work has a clean task boundary and only intended files are staged.
recommendation_types.suggested_task_id_rule: Use the active task id if present; otherwise recommend creating or locating a task anchor before commit.

recommendation_types.allowed_when: Dirty tree contains multiple capabilities, repositories, or unrelated task scopes.
recommendation_types.suggested_task_id_rule: Point to the active task and list adjacent task ids as follow-ups.

recommendation_types.allowed_when: The next step would mutate canonical task state, external systems, secrets, schedules, deletion, or git history.
recommendation_types.suggested_task_id_rule: Point to the approval-policy task or the task that owns the requested action.

recommendation_types.allowed_when: A verified, unique and non-sensitive memory candidate names the exact governed L1 target and carries exact-scope Vincent approval.
recommendation_types.suggested_task_id_rule: Use shared-memory-governance-v2 and route mutation through the existing approval policy and action runner.

recommendation_types.allowed_when: Another repo finished relevant work but harness-mc should receive portable task-state evidence through the event queue.
recommendation_types.suggested_task_id_rule: Use the task id encoded in the event or recommend creating one.

recommendation_types.allowed_when: tasks.json is current but dashboard, Heptabase, or Canvas mirror is stale.
recommendation_types.suggested_task_id_rule: Use the task whose external_refs or generated data are stale.

recommendation_types.allowed_when: External sync is stale or failed and parity can be checked without writing outside $COLLAB.
recommendation_types.suggested_task_id_rule: Use the sync or visual coverage task id.

recommendation_types.allowed_when: A recommendation would write to Heptabase, Notion, Telegram, LaunchAgent, or another external destination.
recommendation_types.suggested_task_id_rule: Use the task that owns the external write and include the exact command or operation.

recommendation_types.allowed_when: Evidence is incomplete, a dependency is missing, or the correct owner cannot be inferred safely.
recommendation_types.suggested_task_id_rule: Use the active task if known; otherwise propose a new task id.

sample_candidates.reason: Sync failure is a high-risk external boundary; dry-run parity should be checked before any write.
sample_candidates.hc_reasoning: Check whether the failure is reproducible before assuming the external system is stale; approval is only needed when moving from dry-run to write.

sample_candidates.reason: A stale blocked task should become an explicit open loop with owner, missing dependency, and next review date.
sample_candidates.hc_reasoning: Treat the blocked item as a feedback-loop gap, not as a prompt to do random work.

sample_candidates.reason: Refreshing an external visual layer can create source-of-truth drift unless the canonical task state is current and Vincent approves the write.
sample_candidates.hc_reasoning: High-risk side effects must stop at approval; utility is only positive if the visual mirror follows tasks.json.

task_governance_sample_candidates.proposed_done_condition: After Vincent approves item 1, the canonical self-learning goal anchor exists and can be fingerprinted before any task reorganization proposal.
limitations: Read-only sample; it does not create or amend a self-learning task.
